title: Freelance Full-Stack Software Engineer
raw_description: SkillFit, a subsidiary of Ideando Inc. is a cutting-edge AI-powered platform that revolutionizes talent acquisition. We are seeking a talented and experienced Freelance Full-Stack Software Engineer. Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks including JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, and Express.js. Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB. Familiarity with cloud platforms AWS, Azure, GCP, and CI/CD pipelines.
